name: codela
description: Production memory for Claude Code: lessons Codela learned from real production incidents in this repo are loaded into every session, so the agent doesn't repeat them.

api_key.title: Codela key (optional)
api_key.description: Optional. /codela:setup fills this in for you. Only set it to use a Codela key you already have (starts with cdl_).

server_url.title: Codela server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the Codela backend that serves this repo's lessons.

repo.title: Repo override
repo.description: owner/name to fetch lessons for. Leave empty to read it from the git remote.
